section_heading: 4.3 MISCELLANEOUS SERVICES / 4.3.1 FIRE AND EMERGENCY SERVICES / 4.3.2 FIRE PROTECTION
plain_summary: This page continues to list fees under '4.3.1 FIRE AND EMERGENCY SERVICES', covering additional chemical protection suits, fire extinguisher foam, and various types of fire extinguishers (water, foam, dry powder, carbon dioxide) including their recharging costs. It also specifies a per-kilometer rate for an emergency support vehicle and introduces fees for Tanker Fire Watch services at the Port of Saldanha, with specific durations (12-36 Hours, 12-48 Hours) and associated maximum fees. A new section, '4.3.2 FIRE PROTECTION', is introduced, detailing hourly rates for vessel and cargo fire protection duties, with specific higher rates for the Port of Durban (which include security), and a flat fee for 'Hotwork' fire safety inspection services.

tables.what_table_lists: Fees for various types of fire extinguishers, including the cost of material, labour, and supervision involved in recharging the equipment.

next_page_reason: The page concludes with sub-section 4.3.2.3, which appears to be the last item under 4.3.2. While section 4.3 (Miscellaneous Services) might continue on the next page with 4.3.3, the current sub-sections seem complete.
ambiguities_or_risks: The fee for 'Tanker Fire Watch – Tug' (e.g., 8,573.08 ZAR for 12-36 Hours) is listed without explicitly stating if it's a flat fee for the entire watch period or a rate per hour within that period. Given the 'Maximum fee' listed immediately after, it is assumed to be a flat fee for the specified watch duration, subject to the maximum.
